title: 第11章 盯梢，嫂嫂轻点
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
就在陆林下树查看的时候。

    南山村。

    陆杨一瘸一拐走进了孙家的大门。

    “孙哥，孙哥，你这边还要等到什么时候啊。”

    “那混账王八蛋，今天竟然当着全村老少的面，把我腿打折了。”

    一见到孙友成，陆杨就骂骂咧咧。

    孙友成面带不善。

    听完陆杨的唠叨和抱怨，孙友成喝了口茶。

    “急什么？”

    陆杨这等混子，在孙友成眼里根本不算什么。

    若不是为了梁心兰，他根本不会搭理这种人。

    “孙哥，这混账小子今天敢打断我的腿，明天就敢在村里称王称霸，到时候连孙哥你说话都不好使。”

    “而且……”

    陆杨压低声音，身体凑近了些。

    “而且这小子每天跟我老婆住在一起，时间久了，难免不会发生点什么。”

    砰！

    “他敢！”

    孙友成一巴掌拍在桌上。

    他知道，陆杨是为了激他，可涉及到梁心兰，这个他惦记了足足三年的女人。

    他孙友成忍不了。

    “陆杨，你给我盯好了陆老二，他若是真敢侵犯你老婆，我带人打死他。”

    “知道知道，孙哥放心。”

    “还有……”

    孙友成沉吟，眼中闪过一丝凶光，“早上听志刚说，陆老二进了山，若是猎到什么东西，把春税的口子给补上，那就有些不妙。”

    他转过目光，看着点头哈腰的陆杨，突然问道：“陆杨，陆老二是你亲弟弟吧。”

    “是，是，孙哥你问这个干什么？”

    孙友成的嘴角勾起，“他既然愿意进山，那就死在山里好了，不知道到时候，你敢不敢下死手。”

    “敢！”

    一听要弄死陆林，陆杨当即站直挺胸。

    “孙哥，这混蛋早就想杀了我这个做大哥的。”

    “他既然无情，那就别怪我无义。”

    “好！”

    孙友成鼓掌，“既然你敢下手，那就好说。等陆老二下次进山，我会让志刚和陆方跟在他后面，到时候，嘿嘿嘿……”

    “孙哥高明啊！”

    陆林死了，家产归他。

    再把梁心兰卖给孙友成，他能不断拿到银钱。

    这般美好的日子正在跟陆杨招手。

    想到这里，陆杨的脸上也露出笑容。

    ……

    “好宝贝！竟然一点事没有。”

    陆林拍去六力弓上面的尘土，心中安定下来。

    只是那两头花豹都被大野猪糟蹋的不成样子，皮子上被撕裂了几十道口子。

    这下别说是缝手套帽子了，恐怕做个裤衩子都不够。

    豹子肉又不好吃，已经彻底没用了。

    不对！
content_en:
Just when Lu Lin was checking under the tree.

    Nanshan Village.

    Lu Yang limped into the door of Sun's house.

    "Brother Sun, Brother Sun, how long do you have to wait here?"

    "That bastard, you broke my leg in front of the whole village today."

    As soon as he saw Sun Youcheng, Lu Yang cursed.

    Sun Youcheng looked evil.

    After listening to Lu Yang's nagging and complaints, Sun Youcheng took a sip of tea.

    "What's the rush?"

    Bastards like Lu Yang were nothing in Sun Youcheng's eyes.

    If it weren't for Liang Xinlan, he would never pay attention to this kind of person.

    "Brother Sun, this bastard dares to break my legs today, and he will dare to dominate the village tomorrow. By then, you won't even be able to speak, Brother Sun."

    "And..."

    Lu Yang lowered his voice and moved closer.

    "And this guy lives with my wife every day. If it lasts for a long time, something will inevitably happen."

    Bang!

    "He dares!"

    Sun Youcheng slapped his hand on the table.

    He knew that Lu Yang was trying to provoke him, but it involved Liang Xinlan, the woman he had been thinking about for three years.

    Sun Youcheng couldn't bear it.

    "Lu Yang, keep an eye on Mr. Lu for me. If he really dares to violate your wife, I will lead my men to beat him to death."

    "I know, I know, Brother Sun, don't worry."

    "And..."

    Sun Youcheng pondered, with a fierce light flashing in his eyes, "I heard from Zhigang this morning that Lu Laoer went into the mountains. If he hunts something and fills up the hole in the spring tax, that would be a little bad."

    He turned his eyes and looked at Lu Yang, who was nodding and bowing, and suddenly asked: "Lu Yang, is Lu Lao Er your biological brother?"

    "Yes, yes, Brother Sun, why do you ask this?"

    The corners of Sun Youcheng's lips curled up, "Since he is willing to go into the mountains, he can just die in the mountains. I don't know if you will dare to kill him when the time comes."

    "Dare!"

    Upon hearing that Lu Lin was going to be killed, Lu Yang immediately stood up straight and raised his chest.

    "Brother Sun, this bastard has long wanted to kill me, the eldest brother."

    "Since he is ruthless, don't blame me for being unrighteous."

    "Okay!"

    Sun Youcheng applauded, "Since you dare to take action, it's easy to say. When Lu Laoer goes into the mountains next time, I will ask Zhigang and Lu Fang to follow him. When the time comes, hehehehe..."

    "Brother Sun is so clever!"

    Lu Lin died, and the family property belonged to him.

    If Liang Xinlan is sold to Sun Youcheng, he can continue to get money.

    Such beautiful days are beckoning to Lu Yang.

    Thinking of this, Lu Yang also had a smile on his face.

    …

    "What a baby! Nothing happened."

    Lu Lin dusted off the Liuli Bow and felt at ease.

    It's just that the two leopards were badly damaged by the big wild boar, and their skins were torn with dozens of holes.

    Let alone sewing gloves and hats now, I'm afraid it's not even enough to make pants.

    Leopard meat is not tasty and is completely useless.
